meta.title: Moniebook Lite dummy dataset, September 2026
meta.warning: Entirely synthetic. Account numbers fail NUBAN validation, phones use an invalid prefix, names are first name plus initial. Do not wire to any real system.

data_dictionary.business_id: BIZ-R retail, BIZ-S services, BIZ-F food and beverage
data_dictionary.direction: credit = money in, debit = money out
data_dictionary.fee_ngn: Transfer or POS fee. Debits: balance reduced by amount+fee. POS credits: balance increased by amount minus fee
data_dictionary.counterparty_type: individual, business, card_customer, biller, merchant, owner, self
data_dictionary.counterparty_account: 10-digit account numbers built to FAIL the NUBAN check digit with a non-existent bank code (999). Cannot validate against a real account. Card values are masked **** test-style last4
data_dictionary.related_txn_id: For reversal credits, the original debit
data_dictionary.running_balance_ngn: Balance after the row. Blank for pending and failed
data_dictionary.category: Month-end categorisation state as the user would see it. Blank = uncategorised
data_dictionary.suggested_category: The app's suggestion for uncategorised items (feed-based confirm)
data_dictionary.flow_group: individual_in, pos_in, business_in, other_in, business_out, individual_out_business, individual_out_personal, business_out_personal, bill_out, cash_out
data_dictionary._fac_*: FACILITATOR ONLY. Ground truth hidden from participants: true category, whether personal, whether the auto category was right
